warnings: C1 is printed with two sections, one per height range ('ฐานราก ถึง พื้น' 0.20x0.20 and 'พื้น ถึง หลังคา' 0.15x0.15) - kept as two entries with a level field (section 8). The 0.055 / 0.03 printed on each is the distance from the face to the bar (cover_mm).

Slabs: main_bar = the bottom mesh both ways; the top bars over the supports go in additional_bars with their printed extension lengths. S1 and S2 differ only in panel size - see the S-02 beam plan warning: the 1.00 x 2.60 panels the S1 section describes are marked S2 on the plan.
S3 prints two Ø9@0.15 callouts, one to the top bar row and one to the bottom row; top recorded as main_bar (cantilever).
